_why: INPUTS for the deterministic price-vs-quantity sweep. Committed so the sweep is REPRODUCIBLE and re-priceable without touching code. Every figure is either MEASURED (live JLCPCB API, with the date) or EXPLICITLY MARKED UNMEASURED. Nothing invented.

_provenance.measured_by: live JLCPCB API (selectSmtComponentList/v2) with positive controls C50645 and C2876746
_provenance._control_note: Controls passed, so this host's API queries return real data. Without a control a total:0 is indistinguishable from a broken query -- the mistake this campaign already made once.

_placements_note: MEASURED: base_station_v1.net declares 44 comps, place_base_station.py places 44/44.
_joints_note: PLACEHOLDER ASSUMPTION. The true per-board joint count needs the footprint pad census, which is NOT yet measured. Set to 1 so the model is transparent rather than silently wrong; every joint-derived figure below is therefore a LOWER BOUND until this is replaced with the real count.

pcb_tiers._src: UNMEASURED -- 4-layer 0.8mm tier, needs a live quote at this size before any order

_pcb_engineering_src: UNMEASURED -- JLC engineering/setup line. Deliberately kept as a SEPARATE term so a real quote can replace one number instead of re-deriving the model.
_pcba_setup_src: UNMEASURED -- stencil + first-article + feeder loading. Kept separate from the per-joint term for the same reason.
_per_joint_src: UNMEASURED -- THIS IS THE FIGURE THE CAMPAIGN FLAGGED AS NEVER MEASURED. 0.0017 is JLC's commonly-quoted 4-lead-free joint rate, entered as a PLACEHOLDER so the model has the right SHAPE. Replace with a measured value.
_bom_src: MEASURED: docs/fab/hub-v9/gerbers/hub_v9-bom-jlcpcb.csv extended-price column, summed for the hub. The ground station shares the same catalogue approach but its BOM is NOT identical -- replace with the base-station BOM total once that CSV is built (it is on the owed list).
_attrition_src: CHOICE, not measurement. 15 percent spares for handling/solder loss. Stated so a reviewer can challenge the number rather than infer it.
_honest_limits: EVERY PCB AND PCBA FIGURE IS A LOWER BOUND: the per-joint fee is unmeasured, the joint count is a placeholder, and the PCB tiers came from a ~1.6mm page default rather than the 0.8mm stackup.
This model is DETERMINISTIC and VERSION-CONTROLLED on purpose: re-run it after replacing any single input and the diff shows exactly what changed.
Do NOT treat the printed totals as quotable prices. They are the SHAPE of the curve until the inputs are measured.
